main_body: A dark gnarled trunk/stump with a few green moss patches, on a grey stone-tile background; irregular organic silhouette
top_band: none - no distinct horizontal top surface; irregular dark brown mass with green patches at rows ~2-3 and ~8
evidence: Reading a middle column, the dark brown wood runs from top to bottom with only moss patches and tonal variation; there is no lighter horizontal top band, no front-edge step and no eave shadow. The shape reads as a flat front view of a gnarled trunk, not a top plus front face construction.

style.evidence: The candidate is a small dark brown trunk fragment with about 3 brown steps and a few green moss dots. It has no canopy and no leaf clumps, and it carries far less shading and detail than the references' multi-green canopies with highlights and trunk grain. It reads as thinner and flatter than the reference trees and is mostly 3-5 colours per tile.
